summary: Fix extraction tool overfitting: remove pattern-adding (Pattern 2) and first-token truncation (Pattern 3), keep only choice-letter normalization; admit realistic predicted scope

edits.hypothesis: Extract the ANSWER: line and normalize only choice-letter format (strip trailing descriptive text after (LETTER)) while preserving all other answer types. This handles format inconsistencies without overfitting or breaking multi-word answers.
edits.targets_mode: answer extraction where models append descriptions after choice letters (format issues only, not reasoning errors)
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Post-hoc deterministic normalization via tool is robust and costs no additional LLM tokens. Prompt-based approaches failed in round 0 on cost.
edits.trigger_condition: Every solve() call; applies to all tasks using ANSWER: format
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) Tasks with trailing descriptions after choice letters ('(D) Rodrigo' → '(D)') would be normalized. (preservative) Multi-word answers ('New York') are preserved; correctly formatted choices pass unchanged; success cases on well-formed ANSWER: lines unaffected. (transfer) General mechanism works for any task pair with choice-letter or free-form answers using ANSWER: format.
edits.regression_risk: Low. Only triggers when answer text starts with (LETTER); for well-formed responses matching the system prompt's format requirement, this is correct behavior. No risk to multi-word or numeric answers since they don't match the (LETTER) pattern.
edits.mechanism: Extract the ANSWER: line and normalize only choice-letter format (strip trailing descriptive text after (LETTER)) while preserving all other answer types. This handles format inconsistencies without overfitting or breaking multi-word answers.
